unit: whole game, both seats and all frames
historical_data: All games completed before the cutoff remain development/diagnostic data. A new hash split does not erase prior exposure to their benchmark results.
gate_policy: Cache without inspecting gate replay moves or labels while developing the candidate. Public outcome/version/rating monitoring remains permitted. Freeze source/model/configuration hashes before opening the gate. Save the gate manifest and paired results; do not tune on the opened gate and continue calling it untouched.
limits: This is a prospective offline replay gate, not a substitute for paired complete matches under 180+2 clocks. Shared openings and repeat opponents create dependence; report uncertainty by game.
